violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment does not require an FMC. No employee certified through an approved course in food safety management was present at the time of inspection. Employees (enough to cover all hours of operation) must successfully complete an approved course in food safety management. List of courses provided. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026

Sanitizer bucket was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must be accessible at all times and must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

TCS foods observed with temperatures of 56 - 61 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Ambient temperature of this unit observed at 39 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Product had been placed in this unit this morning and was stacked well above the lip level of the food container. Product was moved to the lowboy section of the unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
Spray bottles used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Thermometers are lacking in a couple of the refrigeration units. All cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer inside the unit that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2026

Single service utensils observed displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black residue. Oscillating fan in the kitchen observed with a large amount of dust. These areas must be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
The floor in areas of the facility is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
Towels and an empty jug were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025

2-door lowboy unit was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Establishment had already contacted service. Service is scheduled for tomorrow. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Ice had been placed in this unit prior to inspection. Additional ice was added and temperature of unit observed at 41 degrees F at the end of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets of the 2-door lowboy unit and the prep unit were observed in poor repair, splitting away from the door. Gaskets must be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2025

The cutting board of the prep unit is very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2025

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. Inspector reviewed process to set up sanitizing sink. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/16/2023
